</div></div><div  class="column mcb-column mcb-item-dd3203079 one laptop-one tablet-one mobile-one column_column" style="" ><div class="mcb-column-inner mfn-module-wrapper mcb-column-inner-dd3203079 mcb-item-column-inner" ><div class="column_attr mfn-inline-editor clearfix" style=""><p>Welcome to The Kite Point, your new beachfront hub in Praia do Farol, one of Brazil's most authentic and wind-consistent kite spots.</p>
<p>Located right in front of Casa Suiça Kite Villas, The Kite Point is a place to ride, relax, and connect with the growing kite community in this unspoiled paradise.<b></b></p></div></div></div></div></div></div></section><section class="section mcb-section mfn-default-section mcb-section-9xryizkxc  no-margin-h no-margin-v full-width-ex-mobile default-width"   style="" ><div class="mcb-background-overlay"></div><div class="section_wrapper mfn-wrapper-for-wraps mcb-section-inner mcb-section-inner-9xryizkxc"><div  class="wrap mcb-wrap mcb-wrap-jse4ii7f4 one tablet-one laptop-one mobile-one clearfix" data-desktop-col="one" data-laptop-col="laptop-one" data-tablet-col="tablet-one" data-mobile-col="mobile-one" style=""   ><div class="mcb-wrap-inner mcb-wrap-inner-jse4ii7f4 mfn-module-wrapper mfn-wrapper-for-wraps"  ><div class="mcb-wrap-background-overlay"></div><div  class="column mcb-column mcb-item-tybnx9rh one laptop-one tablet-one mobile-one column_heading" style="" ><div class="mcb-column-inner mfn-module-wrapper mcb-column-inner-tybnx9rh mcb-item-heading-inner" ><h3 class="title">GALLERY</h3></div></div><div  class="column mcb-column mcb-item-zfxrszon one laptop-one tablet-one mobile-one column_image_gallery animate" style="" data-anim-type="fadeIn"><div class="mcb-column-inner mfn-module-wrapper mcb-column-inner-zfxrszon mcb-item-image_gallery-inner" >

<ul>
<li>Take-off and landing assistance always available</li>
<li>Kitesurf and wing foil lessons available on request</li>
<li>Open to everyone, guests, visitors, and local kiters</li>
<li>Focused on safety, nature, and good energy</li>
</ul></div></div></div></div></div><div  class="wrap mcb-wrap mcb-wrap-lume4ng2d one-second tablet-one-second laptop-one-second mobile-one clearfix" data-desktop-col="one-second" data-laptop-col="laptop-one-second" data-tablet-col="tablet-one-second" data-mobile-col="mobile-one" style=""   ><div class="mcb-wrap-inner mcb-wrap-inner-lume4ng2d mfn-module-wrapper mfn-wrapper-for-wraps"  ><div class="mcb-wrap-background-overlay"></div><div  class="column mcb-column mcb-item-wslglv0gp one laptop-one tablet-one mobile-one column_heading" style="" ><div class="mcb-column-inner mfn-module-wrapper mcb-column-inner-wslglv0gp mcb-item-heading-inner" ><h4 class="title">kite point lounge</h4></div></div><div  class="column mcb-column mcb-item-nmuv5vff one laptop-one tablet-one mobile-one column_column" style="" ><div class="mcb-column-inner mfn-module-wrapper mcb-column-inner-nmuv5vff mcb-item-column-inner" ><div class="column_attr mfn-inline-editor clearfix" style=""><p>A beachfront space designed to recharge and connect:</p>
<ul>
<li>Fresh drinks, cocktails, and selected wines</li>
<li>Light food served in a relaxed, stylish atmosphere</li>
<li>Chill-out music, shade, and ocean views</li>
<li>The perfect place to take a break between sessions or simply enjoy the vibe</li>
</ul></div></div></div></div></div></div></section><section class="section mcb-section mfn-default-section mcb-section-5p9enmvo8  hide-tablet hide-mobile default-width"   style="" ><div mfn-module-wrapper mcb-column-inner-c12vreevb mcb-item-heading-inner" ><h4 class="title">Why Praia do Farol?</h4></div></div><div  class="column mcb-column mcb-item-tchai23qn one-second laptop-one-second tablet-one-second mobile-one column_column" style="" ><div class="mcb-column-inner mfn-module-wrapper mcb-column-inner-tchai23qn mcb-item-column-inner" ><div class="column_attr mfn-inline-editor clearfix" style=""><p>Strong and steady side-on winds almost daily</p>
<p>Flat water at low tide, wide open space</p></div></div></div><div  class="column mcb-column mcb-item-xhw2r5ncd one-second laptop-one-second tablet-one-second mobile-one column_column" style="" ><div class="mcb-column-inner mfn-module-wrapper mcb-column-inner-xhw2r5ncd mcb-item-column-inner" ><div class="column_attr mfn-inline-editor clearfix" style=""><p>Still off the beaten track, natural, quiet, and authentic</p>
<p>One of the most promising kite destinations in Brazil</p></div></div></div></div></div></div></section><section class="section mcb-section mfn-default-section mcb-section-2244593e9 default-width"   style="" ><div class="mcb-background-overlay"></div><div class="section_wrapper mfn-wrapper-for-wraps mcb-section-inner mcb-section-inner-2244593e9"><div  class="wrap mcb-wrap mcb-wrap-c455ec90e one-second tablet-two-third laptop-one-second mobile-one clearfix" data-desktop-col="one-second" data-laptop-col="laptop-one-second" data-tablet-col="tablet-two-third" data-mobile-col="mobile-one" style=""   ><div class="mcb-wrap-inner mcb-wrap-inner-c455ec90e mfn-module-wrapper mfn-wrapper-for-wraps"  ><div class="mcb-wrap-background-overlay"></div><div  class="column mcb-column mcb-item-dcda5a2dc one laptop-one tablet-one mobile-one column_heading" style="" ><div class="mcb-column-inner mfn-module-wrapper mcb-column-inner-dcda5a2dc mcb-item-heading-inner" ><h3 class="title">THE KITE POINT</h3></div></div><div  class="column mcb-column mcb-item-e574ef18e one laptop-one tablet-one mobile-one column_heading" style="" ><div class="mcb-column-inner mfn-module-wrapper mcb-column-inner-e574ef18e mcb-item-heading-inner" ><h2 class="title">COME AND RIDE WITH US</h2></div></div><div  class="column mcb-column mcb-item-853225054 one laptop-one tablet-one mobile-one column_plain_text" style="" ><div class="mcb-column-inner mfn-module-wrapper mcb-column-inner-853225054 mcb-item-plain_text-inner" ><div class="desc">Whether you're flying your first kite or landing a backroll.<br>
The Kite Point is your place on the beach, for wind, connection, and coastal living.
